voice.why: Account-owned designed voice (free-tier API cannot use library voices or design new ones). Measured on v3: median F0 151 Hz, 8.4 st range, warm spectrum, long deliberate pauses: an old woman's low contralto, timeless accent. Tags steer the delivery from reverent to intimate.

lines.text: Before Veyr had a king, the mountain had a heart.
lines.tts: [slowly] Before Vair had a king... the mountain had a heart.

lines.text: It answered only to blood. And House Vaelor gave it theirs.
lines.tts: [softly] It answered only to blood. And House Vaylor gave it theirs.

lines.text: “The castle remembers its rightful ruler.” So their people were taught.
lines.tts: [reverently] The castle remembers its rightful ruler. [quietly] So their people were taught.

lines.text: On the last night, the gates were sealed… and the king went down to the heart.
lines.tts: [uneasy] On the last night, the gates were sealed... [hushed] and the king went down to the heart.

lines.text: Caer Veyr was torn between two memories of itself.
lines.tts: [sorrowful] Kair Vair was torn... between two memories of itself.

lines.text: The kingdom became a story. Then a warning.
lines.tts: [mournfully] The kingdom became a story. Then a warning.

lines.text: Now, a daughter of the forgotten line has come home.
lines.tts: [tenderly] Now, a daughter of the forgotten line... has come home.
